name: Event e Ikou! Sono 8

Go to a convention, and have sex with a cosplayer!
A must-see girl who becomes your favorite character, as though she's coming out of the product to you!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ096741.html]DLsite[/url]]

Features [url=http://anidb.net/perl-bin/animedb.pl?show=character&charid=19619]Android #18[/url] from Dragon Ball Z.
